svg.aria-label: DNS handoff: with spec.dns.mode DNSEndpoint, the Towonel Hub's confirmed hostnames for an invite flow into towonel-operator's reconcileDNS, which maps the invite region to an edge target and emits a DNSEndpoint custom resource with a CNAME to that edge; a public external-dns instance filtered on the public label creates the CNAME at Cloudflare or any provider, while a LAN external-dns instance filters the public records out and keeps local answers in UniFi. Records are withdrawn when DNS mode is Disabled, the invite is revoked or deleted, there is no edge target, or the tunnel is deleted under the Delete policy; Retain keeps them live. The operator never talks to a DNS provider.
svg.text: Hostnames Confirmed, Records Declared: The Operator Writes, external-dns Publishes
With spec.dns.mode: DNSEndpoint each hub-confirmed hostname becomes a CNAME to its region's edge, vendor-neutral.

text.tspan: • Only hostnames the hub confirms for
• Labels, annotations and providerSpecific copied onto the object.

svg.text: The operator never talks to a DNS provider: it declares records, and whatever reads DNSEndpoints applies them.
